statements.statement: Final health insurance increase for active town and school employees came in below the earlier estimates.
Loss of 40S aid was explained as a Chapter 70 foundation-aid shift attributing per-pupil cost to children; the town expects to cover it with local receipts.
The town manager will present the preliminary FY25 budget to the finance committee on Thursday; the board deferred discussion.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
